context: Add `import` to the spec's CLI list with a one-line description of the bulk path and its refuse-by-default target guard; add a `finding import` row to the skill source's action table and regenerate mirrors with `make skill-sync`; document TODO_DB_FINDING_DRAFTS_DIR where the drafts directory is already described. Match the dense terse house style -- no bash blocks restating content that already exists.
description:
Three surfaces shipped during the findings-domain v4/phase-5 work are documented nowhere an agent or operator would look:

1. `_project/specs/findings-domain.md` CLI section still reads `todo finding create | list | show | candidates | dismiss | triage | link | promote | sync` -- `import` is missing. Zero occurrences of 'finding import' in the spec, which is the master design doc.
2. `.claude/skills/todo-db/SKILL.md`'s action table routes only `finding candidates` / `finding triage` / `finding sync` / `finding promote`. `import` is unroutable, and that skill is HOW agents discover tracker actions -- its own rule 4 says to report a capability gap and stop when an action is not advertised, so an agent asked to import the corpus would correctly conclude the capability does not exist.
3. `TODO_DB_FINDING_DRAFTS_DIR` appears in no doc at all (not AGENTS.md, not the spec, not the skills, not docs/). Its entire purpose is that an operator pins it at the standalone cutover so BenchBox and standalone todo-db agree on the drafts directory. Undocumented, nobody will pin it, and the silent-divergence failure the bridge was built to prevent recurs -- `sync` reporting 'synced 0' while a real draft sits stranded.

The skill is a GENERATED mirror: source lives at /Users/joe/.skill-sync/skills and mirrors are produced by `make skill-sync`. Never hand-edit `.claude/skills/`.

anti_patterns.dont: Document the bulk import without its target guard
anti_patterns.instead: state that --confirm-target <db-name> is required and that the command refuses by default
anti_patterns.why: `--bulk` writes to the shared production tracker; documenting the happy path alone invites an unconfirmed run

anti_patterns.instead: edit the source under /Users/joe/.skill-sync/skills and run `make skill-sync`
anti_patterns.why: it is a generated mirror; a hand edit is overwritten by the next `make skill-sync` and drifts from the tracked snapshot the skill-sync-verify CI gate checks

preserves.behavior: Generated skill mirrors stay generated: any skill text change happens in the skill-sync source and is regenerated
The dense terse house style of AGENTS.md and the spec -- no bash blocks repeating existing content

verifications.description: the spec documents the import subcommand
the drafts-dir env var is documented somewhere an operator will find it

work_units.evidence: Spec CLI section now lists import alongside the other nine subcommands and documents 'todo finding import' (--corpus/--dry-run/--report), that it never touches the corpus files unlike sync's .synced rename, its idempotency and imported_from provenance, triage-log-line-per-event, and 'import --bulk' with its refuse-by-default --confirm-target guard plus the local-backend/token/replica refusals.
work_units.summary: Add `import` (and its --bulk / --confirm-target guard) to the spec's CLI section

work_units.evidence: Added a 'Drafts directory binding' paragraph to the spec: every findings surface resolves through TODO_DB_FINDING_DRAFTS_DIR falling back to ~/.benchbox/finding-drafts/; names the standalone's differing default (~/.todo-db/finding-drafts/<project-id>/); states the divergence is SILENT (sync reports synced 0, banner counts zero, draft stranded); says to pin at cutover; notes an exported-but-empty value is ignored rather than resolving to cwd.
work_units.summary: Document TODO_DB_FINDING_DRAFTS_DIR where the drafts directory is already described, including why it is pinned at cutover
